properties.rationale: User (who:ajs, standing policy from 2026-07-23, re-applied 2026-07-27): validation happens through the trials programme — docs/trials/ is where "built the right thing" is exercised against operational intent; formal validation-kind Verification nodes are not this project's tracking mechanism. Re-fired because cap:evidence-fidelity joined the set (57 → 58). Sharply ironic for this one and worth saying so: the capability that just taught reflow2 to distinguish proof-against-a-model from proof-against-reality is itself proven only by unit tests against a synthetic graph. Its validation is whether, on a real design with a real rig, "proven only in simulation" is a sentence that changes what someone does next — which is a trial, exactly as this standing disposition says.
